source.summary: Raise for negative slice sizes in sliced()

description: sliced(seq, n) with a negative n silently produced a wrong, truncated result (the internal `seq[i : i + n]` generator with i stepping by count(0, n) yields one truncated slice) instead of raising. The real fix adds `if n < 0: raise ValueError('n must be at least 0')` at the top of the function. seed/mod.py is the verbatim pre-fix sliced() extracted standalone; seed/mod_fixed.py is the real fix.
